notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/farama-foundation__highwayenv --backend fake; every gate (G1 to G9) passed, and the run shows the five warnings PLAYBOOK.md section 8 lists as expected of every Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT four times for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index and seed twice). No other warnings; no catalogue requests because the package uses only the catalogue's cap.world.* classes. Evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. What the package covers: highway-v0 (HighwayEnv, highway_env/envs/highway_env.py:17) as a simulated R0 device. The contract is derived from the environment's spaces: cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action} with action.index 0 to 4 (DiscreteMetaAction has five meta-actions, action.py:204), cap.world.reset.v1 takes {seed, options} and cap.world.seed.v1 {seed}; the observation is the Kinematics (5, 5) Box (observation.py:166-172, 207-213) projected as an object of 25 numbers, and the step returns reward, terminated, truncated, tick and state_hash. NOT COVERED: the road scene and the vehicle dynamics. The gate runs without highway_env (the clone needs gymnasium, numpy, pandas, pygame-ce and noise, pyproject.toml:29-37), so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py, fidelity level F0): the ego vehicle changes lane and speed directly, one tick is one policy step of 1/policy_frequency = 1 s, other vehicles are four drifting placeholders and a crash is a distance check on the target lane when the ego changes lane. The clone's IDM/kinematic vehicles integrated over 15 simulation substeps, the road network, the (5, 5) observation array (the fake returns it flattened to 25 numbers), rendering and the reward values of any particular episode are therefore not modelled; the fidelity gaps in driver.py say so. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('highway-v0')) was not run, so the fake was never compared with the upstream environment. The card lists five entry symbols and this package implements one device class (the base HighwayEnv, highway-v0); ExitEnv/ConnectedLaneExitEnv (exit-v0/exit-v1), HighwayEnvFast (highway-fast-v0) and IntersectionEnv (intersection-v0) are registered environments of the clone and are not implemented here. The package is model-authored and unreviewed and nothing here ran on a device.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
